name: clarify
description: Ask 3–10 scored questions with a confidence meter before building a feature or fixing a bug.

interface.shortDescription: Ask scored clarifying questions before building a feature or fixing a bug.
interface.longDescription: Clarify adds two skills, feature and bug. Each reads your designs, specs and code first, then asks 3 to 10 questions one at a time, showing a confidence meter before every question. It stops at 80% confidence, writes a brief (scope, UI states, data, files to change, acceptance criteria or repro steps and a fix plan), and waits for your approval before any code changes.
defaultPrompt: Use Clarify to plan a new settings page from this design.
Use Clarify to pin down why the checkout button does nothing on Safari.
